pages.mainHtml:
Villa Casciano

Property Type

Villa

Bedrooms

6

Bathrooms

6

Living Space

350m²

San Casciano dei Bagni, Siena, Tuscany, Italy

Property Description

The rolling hills, covered in the rich vegetation of vineyards, olive groves, cypress trees, beech woods and chestnut trees, interrupted here and there by the antique habitats of medieval origin. Villa Casciano comes into being as a country farm in the 1700s. The short distance from the thermal baths of Borgo of San Casciano dei Bagni renders a vacation in this area an unforgettable experience, a place in which to find the peace of the past. Recently restored, with the use of natural materials from the area, the villa is able to offer hospitality, care, comfort and space for families or group of friends up to 14 guests. In the summer, thanks to the pool – 15mts by 8mts and five steps,the garden which offers various areas for relaxing, and the wood in which the villa is situated, guests can always find cool areas in which to pass the time and in the winter, the warmth of the house and the many fireplaces, give it a magic atmosphere.

The building is surrounded by 360degrees of gardens, shady areas, oak and olive trees, fruit trees and areas of uncontaminated nature. At night, lights and candles transform the pool area into a magic place for dining, having an aperitif or just looking at the stars. A few metres from the villa there is a small restaurant for the exclusive use on request, of the guests. The chef, Francesco, prepares lunches and dinners guiding the guests in tasting the local products and specialities, with genuine Tuscan recipies. Special attention for vegan, vegetarian, gluten free and allergy menus. Francesco also organizes cooking lessons and pizza parties.

Included in the Price

Fenced infinity pool equipped with shower beds and pergola.

A large sandbox for children or a beach for adults is inserted in the pool area. Dining table under a wisteria pergola next to the kitchen. Covered gazebo with large sofa area facing the pool. Covered terrace on the first floor of the villa. Cottage a short distance from the villa equipped with a wood-burning oven for pizza parties. Cottage with smart working area with large smart TV screen, table for board games, fireplace and wine area available to guests. Special Needs Accommodations

We believe in the inherent value and uniqueness of every child or family member. We are committed to organizing an unforgettable dream vacation with warm, nurturing, and inclusive environments where all children and family members, including those with special needs or disabilities, can thrive. Our specialty trained staff works closely with the owners of the villas to find the best situation for you and your family.

Accommodations

The villa is divided into five areas. The dining room with a great dining table, a pallet fireplace next to the fully equipped kitchen, with access to the garden and the pool terrace. There is a lounge room with books, satellite tv and video cassettes for small children. Bathroom with wc and hand basin. Beside the lounge room there is access to the pergola, shaded with wisteria, with a table for 8, particularly appreciated in the hot summer afternoons for an aperitif. There is a night area here, with 3 bedrooms for adults and children. There is also another night zone with 2 bedrooms completely autonomous in respect to the rest of the house. Going up to the next floor there is the lounge of the great fireplace, panoramic, full of light with comfortable divans for the entire family or a numerous group of friends. A pallet fireplace warms the cooler evenings and the satellite tv and dvd complete the entertainment area. A beautiful covered terrace offers the opportunity of tasting the specialities of the area together with a glass of wine, overlooking the woods. On the same level there are also 2 elegant bedrooms.

Ground Floor

Kitchen with stove, fridge, dishwasher and microwave. Dining room with 14 places at table. Pellet fireplace. Lounge room with TV, couches, Study, Laundry with washing machine and drier. 1 Queen-size bedroom with bathroom ensuite. 1 King-size bedroom with bathroom ensuite. 1 Super king-size bedroom with ensuite bathroom 1 King-size bedroom with ensuite bathroom. All bathrooms have showers. 1 bedroom with single beds. Bathroom with WC and washbasin.

First Floor

Covered terrace with seating. 1 Super King size bedroom, bathroom ensuite with bathtub and shower, 1 King-size bedroom with bathroom ensuite with shower, large lounge room with fireplace, TV, PS4 and DVD

Amenities

Outdoor area: Alfresco dining, BBQ, Heated swimming pool, Outdoor seating, Parking, Ping pong table, Playground with toys

Kitchen: American coffee machine, Blender, Dishwasher, Espresso machine, Fridge for wine, Fridge with freezer, Fruit juicer, Microwave, Oven, Toaster, Water boiler

General: ADSL Wireless Internet Connection, Baby bed, Courtesy line in each bathroom, Dryer, Fireplace, Fully Air Conditioned, Hairdryers in all bathrooms, High chair, Iron and ironing table, Laundry, Mosquito screens, Washing machine

Safety: Emergency first aid kit, Fenced pool, Fenced property, Fire extinguisher

Entertainment: Dock station, DVD player, TV set

House rules: Children welcome, No smoking

Distances

San Casciano dei Bagni is at 2kms on foot, 30 minutes to Pienza, Montalcino, Montepulciano, Civita Bagnoregio,Castiglione del Lago (which also has a beach around the lake). approx. 1 hour to Arezzo, Perugia, Siena, Orvieto, Maremma and the center of Val d’Orcia, 1hour 30 mins to Florence, Roma, The Mall and the beach, 2 kms to the supermarket and various shops at San Casciano dei Bagni, 20/30 minutes to the supermarket and shops at the highway exit at Chiusi.

Property Description

Surrounded by flourishing olive groves and enriched by rolling gardens, the residence offers unforgettable holidays and permits the guests to quickly reach the renowened artistic and historical cities of Florence, Siena, Cortona, Assisi, Montepulciano and Chianti. All the original characteristics of the villa have been maintained: the cotto flooors, the windows and doors surrounded in stone, wooden beams and brick ceilings have all been restored using the original materials of the villa.

The interior decorating includes antique furniture and precious materials, and the care of details and antique objects enrich the elegant and exclusive atmosphere. There are two swimming pools. The inside pool is heated and has a hydromassage and sauna. The outside pool (12 x 6 meters and 1.20 – 2.00 meters deep) reached by a Roman stairway, is fenced and surrounded by gardens. It is possible to enjoy a breathtaking view whilst relaxing in the shade of the gazebo. The villa also offers the advantage of a veranda with sliding glass windows, which enable the use of air conditioning in the hottest of evenings.

Ground Floor

Entrance, lounge with fireplace and bar, dining room, modern professional kitchen, glassed in veranda with view for dining, laundry with washing machine, and one bathroom with toilet and hand basin. Property Description

Villa Dell’Angelo is a luxury villa in perfect Tuscan style, typical historical and refined in the smallest detailes. Located in the middle of the Tuscan hills, on the last western slopes of Mount Albano, approximately 250 mt. above sea level. Close to the most important cities as Florence, Lucca, Pisa, easily reachable with every mean of transport. The swimming Pool (8 mt.×16 mt. and depth from 1.35 to 2,50 mt), is exclusive to the guests of Dell’Angelo. It is an infinity pool with a very large hydromassage area for 8 guests. Under the pool there is a large changing room with 2 showers and WC.

Around the pool there is a large sunbathing area with umbrellas, chairs, tables and sunbeds. The cleaning system of the pool insures utmost hygene and eliminates any possible inconvenience caused by the chloride. The swimming pool has an automatic system for maintaining the correct values of the PH and of the chlorine. Further down the pool there is a relaxation place with an antique marble table and chairs in stone. There is also a children’s corner.

For almost 50 years the owners have cultivated their passion for antiques and have furnished the villa with pieces acquired from antique dealers, auction sales or antique fairs. Some of the more particular pieces are the beautiful doors in each room. Particularly the two doors in the central lounge and the one of the green bedroom on ground floor. All of 17th cent. The kitchen has a double marble sink, 250 years old and a collection of 12 ceramic tiles with zodiac symbols of the beginning of last century, over the stove.

Worth notice is a big 17th century chestnut plaque over the wide stairs down into the big lounge/dining room. In this spacious room there is a magnificent set of 10 chestnut Florentine chairs of the 17th centuty and a spectacular and remarkable stone fire place from the Northern part of Italy, which dates back to the 16th century. In the master bedroom a double painted 18th cent. door from a noble palace in Naples and a 17th century chest. In the red bedroom a very fine Louis XV wardrobe. There are many antique prints on the walls from different parts of Italy (Venice, Rome, Naples etc). Objects d’art can be seen throughout the villa. All the rooms have Persian carpets. Many other pieces, more or less important, have all been chosen in the spirit of tracing our roots back to the past. Also in the garden one can find stone pieces, as well as old terrracotta Tuscan vases.

Ground Floor

Large lounge-dining room which seats up to 14 people and has a large fireplace with lounges and armchairs. There is also a lovely view of the garden and pool area as well as views looking up to the old town (the original town) of Monsummano Alto. Another sitting come lounge room which leads to the big Tuscan kitchen with its own fireplace and antique style oven. On this floor there is a bathroom decorated with an antique basin and floor but with modern design shower . There is also a double bedroom which gives onto a covered verandah with table and chairs (actually church pews) for eating overlooking the pool and hillside towns.

First Floor

They are furnished with antique furniture, paintings and Persian carpets. From the entrance there is a stone staircase leading to the bedrooms It has a beautiful wrought iron 17thC bannister. On the floor of the middle and top landings of the staricase there are cotto tiles dipicting the Florentine lily. On the ceiling there are cotto rosettes painted in imitation bronze. One main bedroom (30 sq.mtrs.) with its own bathroom with Turkishbath/shower and a lovely view up to Monsummano Alto which is lit up at night. Another bedroom which is a little smaller and has a view over the valley, olive groves, woods and pool. It shares a bathroom (with a Jacuzzi bath and shower with light and aroma therapy) with the third bedroom which has two single beds which, on rerquest, can be put together to form a double bed. This also has a pigeon hole window which looks up to Monsummano Alto (Alto means “on high”). All the upstairs bedrooms have antique cotto floors and beams, which have been restored with taste and care by the owners.

Amenities

Outdoor area: Alfresco dining, BBQ, Outdoor jacuzzi (not heated), Outdoor seating, Parking, Playground with toys, Private swimming pool, Stunning view

Kitchen: American coffee machine, Blender, Coffee machines (moka), Dishwasher, Espresso machine, Fridge with ice maker, Fruit juicer, Microwave, Oven, Toaster, Water boiler

General: ADSL Wireless Internet Connection, Air conditioning, Baby bed, Clothes-dryer, Courtesy line in each bathroom, Dryer, Fireplace, Fully Air Conditioned, Hairdryers in all bathrooms, Heating, High chair, Hot Tub, Iron and ironing table, Laundry, Mosquito screens, Thermostatic mixer, Washing machine

Safety: Alarm system, Emergency first aid kit, Fenced property, Fire extinguisher, Safe, Smoke detector

Gym and Wellness: Gym, Hydromassages (Jacuzzi tub or shower), Turkish bath

Entertainment: Bluetooth Bose acoustic speakers, DVD player, Netflix, Stereo HI FI Bluetooth, TV set

House rules: Children welcome, Events allowed, No smoking

Distances

Monsummano Terme (nearest shops and supermarkets) 2,5 km Florence km 40 min 35 (airport), Pisa km45 min 40 (airport), Siena km90 min 90.

Property Type

600m²

Guardistallo, PI, Tuscany, Italy

Property Description

The villa’s panoramic site offers magnificent views from the pool and from the patio. All the rooms on the ground floor lead into the garden which surrounds the house. There are two private parking areas, two dining areas with large tables, stone BBQ, a splendid infinity pool: everything to enable you to spend relaxed evenings with friends, perhaps with a Florentice steak and sipping a glass of good Tuscan red wine.

The strategic position of the villa permits easy access to the local wellness center and natural spas, situated in the Montescudaio DOC area, at the edge of the Terratico of Bibbona and it is only 15 km from the town of Bolgheri and its world famous vineyards which produce the Supertuscan wines (Sassicaia, Ornellaia, Masseto, etc).

Included in the Price

Heatable infinity pool 10×5 mtrs and 150 cm depth.

Special Needs Accommodations

We believe in the inherent value and uniqueness of every child or family member. We are committed to organizing an unforgettable dream vacation with warm, nurturing, and inclusive environments where all children and family members, including those with special needs or disabilities, can thrive. Our specialty trained staff works closely with the owners of the villas to find the best situation for you and your family.

Accommodations

Interiors are extremely well presented in the original Tuscan architecture with arches, vaulted ceilings and colors which render the home warm and welcoming. The villa's comfort and simplicity provide a relaxing place to spend a day and a pleasant place to return in the evening after a long day of tourism to feel extra spoiled.

The villa has a total of 9 double bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms. Two are on the ground floor and have direct access to the garden and the other 7 are on the first floor. One of the bedrooms has a private lounge with the possibility of another 2 beds. All the bedrooms have AC.

Ground Floor

2 double bedrooms with bathrooms, 2 kitchens, 2 lounge rooms, 2 salons with fireplace, 1 service bathroom

First Floor

6 double bedrooms with bathrooms, 1 double bedroom with bathroom ensuite

Amenities

Outdoor area: Alfresco dining, BBQ, Heated swimming pool, Parking, Ping-pong table, Pizza oven, Private swimming pool, Stunning view

Kitchen: American coffee machine, Blender, Espresso pt (moka), Dishwasher, Espresso machine, Fridge with freezer, Fruit juicer, Microwave, Oven, Toaster, Kettle

General: ADSL Wireless Internet Connection, Air conditioning, Crib, Courtesy line in each bathroom, Hairdryers in all bathrooms, Heating, High chair, Iron and ironing table, Mosquito screens, Washing machine

Safety: Emergency first aid kit, Fenced pool, Fire extinguisher, Safe

Entertainment: DVD player, Stereo Hifi, Tv set

House rules: Events allowed, No smoking

Distances

Casale Marittimo(closet shops) 4 km; Marina di Bibbona (closet beaches) 17 km; Volterra 31,6 km; San Gimignano 61 km; Pisa Aeroporto 73 km; Siena 85,5 km; Lucca 95,7 km; Firenze 126 km.

Terms & Conditions

Check In: From 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM Check Out: By 9:30 AM

Swimming Pool: open from 06 May- 30 September

Not included in the rental price: Final cleaning €490, Heating upon consumption, not compulsory, Pool heating Available when the house heating is not switch on. The system could heat the house or the swimming pool. A/C upon consumption, not compulsory. Security deposit €900, Pets €50, Local taxes.

Property Location

Guardistallo, PI, Tuscany, Italy

Property Description

The property has been very carefully restored in 2010 in respect of the typical Tuscan traditions. It hosts 20 guests in ensuite bedrooms for a holiday with maximum tranquillity.

There is a private parking area, a covered portico with two large dining tables, a BBQ, play area for children and a splendid heatable pool 12x 6 mtrs depth 150 cm. The villa is also equipped with wi-fi and AC. To sum up, it is the ideal place to spend pleasant evenings with friends without having to worry about bothering neighbours, perhaps with a famous Flrorentine steak of a bottle of Bolgheri DOC.

Accommodations

The villa is divided into two independent apartments, one for 8 guests and the other for 14. It has a total of 10 bedrooms, each with private bathroom, plus a tower with two beds and a bathroom. The smaller apartment for 8 has two double bedrooms with bathroom on the ground floor, open kitchen, dining area with fireplace, plus 2 double bedrooms with canopies and bathrooms on the first floor. The bigger apartment, for 14 people, has 2 double bedrooms with bathroom on the ground floor, lounge room, open kitchen, fire place, dining area and 4 double bedrooms with canopies and bathroom on the first floor. From this apartment one can enter the tower with 2 double sofabeds and a bathroom. All the areas on the ground floor of the villa and one of the bedrooms in the smaller apartment lead into the garden, which surrounds the house.

2 double bedrooms with bathrooms, 2 x 2 single bedrooms with bathrooms, 2 kitchens, lounge area, 2 dining rooms with fireplaces, 1 service bathroom

Property Description

The name of the nearest village is Guardistallo, in the province of Pisa and is on the Etruscan coast, just 13 km from the sea. In the surrounding area there are many interesting country towns to visit, such as Montescudaio, without doubt one of the most beautiful towns in the Pisa area, Ripabella, and Casale Marittimo.

The farmhouse has been faithfully restored according to the Tuscan tradition. It is in an open position and dominates a 360 degree view of the countryside, isolated and tranquil. The climate is perfect from April through October and winter is usually very mild. The private pool can be heated and has a spectacular view on the surrounding hills, with umbrellas and pool loungers. There is a panoramic terrace with BBQ. Free Internet is available. The heated pool is 6×12 mts and cm 1.50 deep. The solarium is equipped with 8 loungers, 8 lie-lows and 4 chairs. It has a panoramic terrace facing South and a staircase leading directly to the garden. The terrace has a bbq, loungers, umbrellas, table and chairs. Outside there is another bbq with oven.

In the surrounding area there are many interesting country towns to visit, such as Montescudaio, without doubt one of the most beautiful towns in the Pisa area, Ripabella, and Casale Marittimo.
The farmhouse has been faithfully restored according to the Tuscan tradition . It is in an open position and dominates a 360 degree view of the countryside, isolated and tranquil. The climate is perfect from April through October and winter is usually very mild. The private pool can be heated and has a spectacular view on the surrounding hills, with umbrellas and pool loungers. There is a panoramic terrace with BBQ. Free Internet is available. The heated pool is 6×12 mts and cm 1.50 deep. The solarium is equipped with 8 loungers, 8 lie-lows and 4 chairs. It has a panoramic terrace facing South and a staircase leading directly to the garden. The terrace has a bbq, loungers, umbrellas, table and chairs. Outside there is another bbq with oven.

The Villa is on two levels and is approximately 600 square metres.. It can host 16 people in two apartments, each with 4 bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms. The two apartments are independent, but can be connected by an inside staircase. 5 extra beds can be added for a total of 21 guests. On the ground floor (appr 300 sq mts) there is a large lounge room with tv area, a dining area, kitchen and 4 double bedrooms, all with private bathroom with shower. The kitchen and areas downstairs are ideal for 16 people. An inside staircase leads to the upper floor (appr 290 sq mts). This has a kitchen with view, dining area, lounge, 4 bedrooms with 4 bathrooms ensuite and an extra courtesy bathroom. AC in all the rooms.

Property Description

OVERVIEW

The villa is located in the middle of the Tuscan hills, close to the most important cities such as Florence, Lucca, Pisa, easily reachable by car, by various local transport means or by using our shuttle bus service. The exterior of the villa is characterized by a large garden with lawn, fully Tuscan vegetation (olive trees, small vineyards). You can find 3 Gazebos, one on the side of the villa, with a large table and equipped barbeque, a second, in front of the villa where you can comfortably relax on the sofas, enjoying the Tuscan sunset, savoring typical products waiting for dinner.

Moving one level lower than the villa we find a third Gazebo where you can have breakfast or aperitifs by the pool. The garden is also equipped with a small playground for children with a slide and a swing. Villa Roncovisi also enjoys a private pool for guests, (6 x 12 m with depth 1.40 mt ). It is located on a natural terrace, a couple of meters below the level of the villa, it is a pee with infinity, so

it enjoys a fantastic view of the surrounding hills, also equipped with a whirlpool. Under the pool you will find a dressing room equipped with a shower and a toilet, where you can change into total comfort. There is also a children’s corner.

CIR: 047009AAT0016

Special Needs Accommodations

We believe in the inherent value and uniqueness of every child or family member. We are committed to organizing an unforgettable dream vacation with warm, nurturing, and inclusive environments where all children and family members, including those with special needs or disabilities, can thrive. Our specialty trained staff works closely with the owners of the villas to find the best situation for you and your family.

Accommodations

For almost 50 years the owners have cultivated their passion for antiques and have furnished the villa with pieces acquired from antique dealers, auction sales or antique fairs. Some of the more particular pieces are the beautiful doors of the walk-in wardrobes in two of the bedrooms, the wooden 17th century plaque from a Florentine convent above the door of one of loungeroom. Two of the bedrooms have Empire wardrobes and chests of drawers.

The owners’ taste is eclectic and includes some pieces of Liberty period furniture, for example, the French mirror in the green bathroom and the Sicilian chest of drawers in the yellow bedroom. There is a late Empire sideboard in another of the loungerooms.

There are many antique prints on the walls, including geographical maps of various countries, and in some of the bedrooms and lounge rooms there are chests of the 16th and 17th century. Another remarkable piece is the billiard table, dating back to the early nineteen hundreds – in perfect condition. Many other pieces, more or less important, have all been chosen in the spirit of tracing our roots back to the past. Also in the garden one can find stone pieces, as well as old

terrracotta Tuscan vases.

Ground Floor

Part A: Main kitchen with table for 8, fireplace and antique bread and pizza oven (not usable), side by side fridge with icemaker – Lounge room with two couches and double faced fireplace leading into lounge/dining room with table for 16 – TV room with sofa bed for two, armchair, divans, piano and electric keyboard – Billiard room with 2 armchairs and wardrobe – Downstairs bathroom with Jacuzzi shower – Laundry

Ground Floor

Part B: Dining room for 8 people – Lounge room with antique fire place (not usable), couches, card table with 4 chairs. – Well equipped kitchen for 6 with oven – Downstairs bathroom with Jacuzzi shower – Two staircases (16 steps in part A and 13 in part B) – All bedrooms have beside tables.

First Floor

Part A: – Blue bedroom: double bedroom with king-size bed, wardrobe, 1 chests of drawers, ensuite with Jacuzzi shower; balcony reached by a spiral staircase with single bed. – Triple bedroom with 3 single beds, wardrobe and chest of drawers. – Bedroom with single bed, built-in wardrobe and chest of drawers. – Bathroom with Jacuzzi bath and shower, shared by the bedroom with 3 single beds and the single room. – Intermediate floor: above the large dining room and reached by a staircase of 9 stairs, a bedroom with 2 single beds. The bathroom is downstairs.

First Floor

Part B: – Yellow bedroom: double bedroom with king-size bed and ensuite bathroom with Jacuzzi. (hydromassage bath and shower, walk-in wardrobe, antique chest, chest of drawers, two armchairs with small toilette) – Green bedroom: Double bedroom with king-size bed and ensuite with Jacuzzi shower, walk-in wardrobe and chest of drawers. – Pink bedroom: double bedroom with king-size bed and ensuite with Jacuzzi shower, wardrobe, chest of drawers.

Amenities

Outdoor area: Alfresco dining, BBQ, Outdoor seating, Parking, Playground with toys, Private swimming pool, Stunning views

Kitchen: American coffee machine, Blender, Coffee machines (moka), Dishwasher, Espresso machine, Fridge with freezer, Fridge with ice maker, Fruit juicer, Microwave, Oven, Toaster, Water boiler

General: ADSL Wireless Internet Connection, Baby bed, Billiard room, Clothes-dryer, Courtesy line in each bathroom, Fireplace, Fully Air Conditioned, Hairdryers in all bathrooms, Heating, High chair, Iron and ironing table, Laundry, Mosquito screens, Piano, Thermostatic mixer, Washing machine

Safety: Emergency first aid kit, Fenced property, Fire extinguisher, Safe, Smoke detector

Gym and Wellness: Hydromassages (Jacuzzi tub or shower)

Entertainment: Bluetooth Bose acoustic speakers, DVD player, Netflix, Stereo HI FI Bluetooth, Tv sat

House rules: Children welcome, Events allowed, No smoking

Distances

Monsummano Terme (nearest shops and supermarkets) 2,5 km Florence km40 min 35 (airport), Pisa km45 min 40 (airport), Siena km90 min 90.

Terms & Conditions

- first breakfast: milk, coffee, tea, jam, butter, toasted bread, cereal, juice

In the kitchen you will find all the basics: oil, salt, pepper, vinegar, etc.

The villa is located in the middle of the Tuscan hills, close to the most important cities such as Florence, Lucca, Pisa, easily reachable by car, by various local transport means or by using our shuttle bus service. The exterior of the villa is characterized by a large garden with lawn, fully Tuscan vegetation (olive trees, small vineyards). You can find 3 Gazebos , one on the side of the villa, with a large table and equipped barbeque, a second, in front of the villa where you can comfortably relax on the sofas, enjoying the Tuscan sunset, savoring typical products waiting for dinner.
Moving one level lower than the villa we find a third Gazebo where you can have breakfast or a peritifs by the pool . The garden is also equipped with a small playground for children with a slide and a swing. Villa Roncovisi also enjoys a private pool for guests, (6 x 12 m with depth 1.40 mt ). It is located on a natural terrace, a couple of meters below the level of the villa, it is a pee with infinity, so
it enjoys a fantastic view of the surrounding hills, also equipped with a whirlpool . Under the pool you will find a dressing room equipped with a shower and a toilet, where you can change into total comfort. There is also a children’s corner .

sections.heading: Accommodations
sections.html:
For almost 50 years the owners have cultivated their passion for antiques and have furnished the villa with pieces acquired from antique dealers, auction sales or antique fairs. Some of the more particular pieces are the beautiful doors of the walk-in wardrobes in two of the bedrooms, the wooden 17th century plaque from a Florentine convent above the door of one of loungeroom. Two of the bedrooms have Empire wardrobes and chests of drawers.

The owners’ taste is eclectic and includes some pieces of Liberty period furniture, for example, the French mirror in the green bathroom and the Sicilian chest of drawers in the yellow bedroom. There is a late Empire sideboard in another of the loungerooms.

There are many antique prints on the walls, including geographical maps of various countries, and in some of the bedrooms and lounge rooms there are chests of the 16th and 17th century. Another remarkable piece is the billiard table, dating back to the early nineteen hundreds – in perfect condition. Many other pieces, more or less important, have all been chosen in the spirit of tracing our roots back to the past. Also in the garden one can find stone pieces, as well as old

terrracotta Tuscan vases.

Ground Floor

Part A: Main kitchen with table for 8, fireplace and antique bread and pizza oven (not usable), side by side fridge with icemaker – Lounge room with two couches and double faced fireplace leading into lounge/dining room with table for 16 – TV room with sofa bed for two, armchair, divans, piano and electric keyboard – Billiard room with 2 armchairs and wardrobe – Downstairs bathroom with Jacuzzi shower – Laundry

Ground Floor

Part B: Dining room for 8 people – Lounge room with antique fire place (not usable), couches, card table with 4 chairs. – Well equipped kitchen for 6 with oven – Downstairs bathroom with Jacuzzi shower – Two staircases (16 steps in part A and 13 in part B) – All bedrooms have beside tables.

First Floor

Part A: – Blue bedroom: double bedroom with king-size bed, wardrobe, 1 chests of drawers, ensuite with Jacuzzi shower; balcony reached by a spiral staircase with single bed. – Triple bedroom with 3 single beds, wardrobe and chest of drawers. – Bedroom with single bed, built-in wardrobe and chest of drawers. – Bathroom with Jacuzzi bath and shower, shared by the bedroom with 3 single beds and the single room. – Intermediate floor: above the large dining room and reached by a staircase of 9 stairs, a bedroom with 2 single beds. The bathroom is downstairs.

First Floor

Part B: – Yellow bedroom: double bedroom with king-size bed and ensuite bathroom with Jacuzzi. (hydromassage bath and shower, walk-in wardrobe, antique chest, chest of drawers, two armchairs with small toilette) – Green bedroom: Double bedroom with king-size bed and ensuite with Jacuzzi shower, walk-in wardrobe and chest of drawers. – Pink bedroom: double bedroom with king-size bed and ensuite with Jacuzzi shower, wardrobe, chest of drawers.

Property Description

The Villa is surrounded by a large garden with barbecue area and is equipped with a private seasonal outdoor swimming pool (12 x 6 mt, 1.40 mt deep) with umbrellas and sunbeds.. Parking is adjacent to the structure.

In recent years, with the intention of eco-friendly innovation, the villa has been equipped with heating with an ecological pellet boiler and an air conditioning system. Free Wi-Fi Internet connection is also available.

The Villa is part of the Sant’Andrea agricultural company that extends over 600 hectares in the Chianti Classico area and has as its center the ancient village of Fabbrica, where the Villa, the Church of Sant’Andrea and the wine aging cellars are also located. Around the village, the slopes with the best exposures have been designated as vineyards, which are located approximately 250 m above sea level and occupy approximately 50 hectares of surface area. The company’s agricultural activity also takes place on the hills on which olive groves stand, while the valleys and flat stretches are cultivated with arable land, part of which is irrigated thanks to the water coming from the company’s two large lakes. The Villa Sant’Andrea agricultural company is part of the “Fabbrica – Santa Cristina” wildlife-hunting company; for those who love walking and cycling, the surrounding area, covered by forests of oaks, holm oaks, acacias, cypresses and pastures, where the typical wild animals of our area are present, offers numerous itineraries in a splendid and uncontaminated landscape.

Special Needs Accommodations

We believe in the inherent value and uniqueness of every child or family member. We are committed to organizing an unforgettable dream vacation with warm, nurturing, and inclusive environments where all children and family members, including those with special needs or disabilities, can thrive. Our specialty trained staff works closely with the owners of the villas to find the best situation for you and your family.

Accommodations

Furnished with exposed oak beams, terracotta floors and Tuscan rustic furniture, the result of a careful renovation which has preserved the materials and ancient structures unchanged, such as the stable on the ground floor with the manger which now houses a large hall suitable for meetings and receptions, up to 50 people and the characteristic still working fireplace, at the entrance, overlooking the lawn.

In front of the main entrance of the villa there is a large outdoor area with pergola and loggia; Covered dining area and BBQ area available.

Adjacent to the main entrance on the ground floor and accessible from the garden, laundry room with washing machine available.

Ground Floor

On the ground floor large living room with fireplace, kitchen, meeting room, a bedroom with two single beds, a double bedroom and a bathroom with shower.

First Floor

On the first floor accessible by a large stone staircase: large living room with adjoining dining room, kitchen, and 3 bedrooms:

One double bedrooms with adjacent bathroom with shower.

One double bedrooms with adjacent bathroom with shower and bathtub.

One bedroom with single beds and adjacent bathroom with shower.

Second Floor

On the second floor accessible by wooden staircase, large study which can be used as a bedroom with two single beds.

Amenities

Outdoor forniture: Alfresco dining, Aromatic garden, BBQ, Outdoor seating, Parking, Private swimming pool, Stunning view

Kitchen: Coffee machines (moka), Dishwasher, Espresso machine, Fridge with freezer, Fruit juicer, Oven, Toaster, Water boiler

General: Free Wi-Fi, Air conditioning, Baby bed, Courtesy line in each bathroom, Hairdryers in all bathrooms, Heating, High chair, Iron and ironing table, Laundry, Washing machine

Safety: Emergency first aid kit, Fenced property, Fire extinguisher Entertenment: Tv sat
House rules: Children welcome, Events allowed, No smoking

Distances

Tavarnelle Val di Pesa (nearest shops and supermarkets) km 7 min 10, Pisa km 85 min 90 (airport), Firenze km 35 min 35 (airport), Siena km 50 min 40, San Gimignano km 35 min 35, Volterra km 55 min 55, Montalcino km 90 min 800

Swimming Pool: Opening dates vary based on weather, approximately can consider from the end of April to mid-October

The Villa Sant’Andrea agricultural company is part of the “Fabbrica – Santa Cristina” wildlife-hunting company; for those who love walking and cycling, the surrounding area, covered by forests of oaks, holm oaks, acacias, cypresses and pastures, where the typical wild animals of our area are present, offers numerous itineraries in a splendid and uncontaminated landscape.

Property Description

Torre del Cielo is the result of the care for detail for every aspect of modern hospitality the complete comfort of the guests. The name of this ancient 17th century building comes from its position, “Tower in the Sky”; from here one can admire a fantastic panorama over the Valtiberina and the Tuscan hills. Torre del Cielo was originally a lookout guard tower, built about the first half of the 1600 by Ferdinand II of the Medici, used by a small group of soldiers to guard against the arrival of the enemy. Its position is about 2,5 kms from Monterchi, the last piece of the land of the Granduke of Tuscany, close to the Papal State and world famous for its frescoes by Piero della Francesca the Madonna del Parto. In 1894 Francesco Rosadi (the year of construction is sculptered on the ground floor fireplace), the grandfather of the actual owner, extended the tower, giving it the form and the dimension that we can admire today.

The”villa” has recently been restored, maintaining all the characteristics of a typical Tuscan country house. The villa has a big swimming pool (depth 150 cm, 6×12 mts), for moments of refreshing relaxation in the summer season. The pool is surrounded by sunbeds, umbrellas and a gazebo for enjoying the summer in total privacy. It is surrounded by a large garden from which one can admire the view over the panoramic valley below, perhaps relaxing in the Jacuzzi beside the pool. Moving to a slightly lower garden level there is a delightful patio where there is “al fresco” dining table for 10 people.

The 2 hectar garden is looked after with great passion by the owners. There are olive trees, biological peach and plum trees, to which the guests are invited to "help themselves”. There are roses, lavender and rosemary which fill the air with delightful, typical Tuscan perfumes, very difficult to forget. For sport lovers there is a small football field (for 5), a ping pong table and lovely long walks through the oak woods which surround the property, Torre del Cielo is the ideal location for an unforgettable holiday in the middle of the Tuscan countryside.

Special Needs Accommodations

We believe in the inherent value and uniqueness of every child or family member. We are committed to organizing an unforgettable dream vacation with warm, nurturing, and inclusive environments where all children and family members, including those with special needs or disabilities, can thrive. Our specialty trained staff works closely with the owners of the villas to find the best situation for you and your family.

Accommodations

The villa is 250 sqm and before we go inside we would like to admire the original structure from the outside. The form, as well as the material used, are typical of this area. Stone is the dominating material, but also wood plays its part, as does the wrought iron used in the outside furniture. The windows have been modernized, but the style fits in well with that of the villa. Some of the original wooden doors on the inside have been restored maintaining the original style. The most important part of any hospitality structure is obviously the bedrooms. The bedrooms, all with AC, represent the highlight of the Tuscan rustic style. Wood, “cotto”, wrought iron materials. The furnishing are simple, almost severe, but this is part of the Tuscan country house. On the other hand, in the bedrooms we can find the perfect combination between rustic style and modern comforts.

Ground Floor

There is a spacious well equipped kitchen, a beautiful dining room with antique fireplace and the characteristic reading room. Kitchen with fridge, microwave oven, stove and burners, American coffee machine, toaster, and dishwasher. Diningroom which seats 10 people, counch and armchairs, satelitte TV, telephone, stereo.

First Floor

On the 1st floor the guests have 4 bedrooms, tastefully furnished in Tuscan style, the beds are in wrought iron and the furnishings are antique. All have bathrooms ensuite with WC, bidet, basin, shower with thermostatic mixer. 2 double bedrooms, one of which can be divided into a double twin bedroom with ensuite bathroom with WC, bidet, basin, shower with thermostatic mixer. 2 twin bedrooms, which can be made into 2 double bedrooms with ensuite bathroom with WC, bidet, basin, shower with thermostatic mixer.

Tower

There is also a characteristic tower which has a separate entrance from the rest of the villa. There is a small sitting room with divan and table, a comfortable bathroom with a shower on the ground floor. On the 1sr floor there is a double bedroom with a large terrace and splendid view over the valley.

Amenities

Outdoor area: Alfresco dining, BBQ, Covered parking, Outdoor Jacuzzi (heated), Outdoor seating, Ping pong table, Private swimming pool, Stunning view

Kitchen: American coffee machine, Blender, Coffee machines (moka), Dishwasher, Fridge with ice maker, Fruit juicer, Microwave, Oven, Toaster, Kettle

General: AC In All The Bedrooms, ADSL Wireless Internet Connection, Baby bed, Courtesy line in each bathroom, Hairdryers in all bathrooms, Heating, High chair, Iron and ironing table, Mosquito screens, Thermostatic mixer, Washing machine

Safety: Emergency first aid kit, Fire extinguisher

Entertainment: DVD player, Stereo HI FI Bluetooth, TV set

Distances

Arezzo 29 km (18 mi), Cortona 48 km (30 mi), Gubbio 67 km, Perugia 70 km and Montepulciano 77 km. The highway is only 27 km from the villa, bus in Monterchi 2,5 kms and train station at (Arezzo 23 km), airprot: Perugia 55 kms, Firenze 120 kms

Terms & Conditions

Check In: From 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM Check Out: By 10:00 AM Swimming Pool: Open from 25 April - 10 October

Not included in the rental price: Final cleaning 200€, Security deposit 500€, A/C 0.80€ per kWh, Heating 6.5€ per cubic meter, Hot tub 300€ per week.

sections.heading: Accommodations
sections.html:
The villa is 250 sqm and before we go inside we would like to admire the original structure from the outside. The form, as well as the material used, are typical of this area. Stone is the dominating material, but also wood plays its part, as does the wrought iron used in the outside furniture. The windows have been modernized, but the style fits in well with that of the villa. Some of the original wooden doors on the inside have been restored maintaining the original style. The most important part of any hospitality structure is obviously the bedrooms. The bedrooms, all with AC, represent the highlight of the Tuscan rustic style. Wood, “cotto”, wrought iron materials. The furnishing are simple, almost severe, but this is part of the Tuscan country house. On the other hand, in the bedrooms we can find the perfect combination between rustic style and modern comforts.

Ground Floor

There is a spacious well equipped kitchen, a beautiful dining room with antique fireplace and the characteristic reading room. Kitchen with fridge, microwave oven, stove and burners, American coffee machine, toaster, and dishwasher. Diningroom which seats 10 people, counch and armchairs, satelitte TV, telephone, stereo.

First Floor

On the 1st floor the guests have 4 bedrooms, tastefully furnished in Tuscan style, the beds are in wrought iron and the furnishings are antique. All have bathrooms ensuite with WC, bidet, basin, shower with thermostatic mixer. 2 double bedrooms, one of which can be divided into a double twin bedroom with ensuite bathroom with WC, bidet, basin, shower with thermostatic mixer. 2 twin bedrooms, which can be made into 2 double bedrooms with ensuite bathroom with WC, bidet, basin, shower with thermostatic mixer.

Tower

There is also a characteristic tower which has a separate entrance from the rest of the villa. There is a small sitting room with divan and table, a comfortable bathroom with a shower on the ground floor. On the 1sr floor there is a double bedroom with a large terrace and splendid view over the valley.

Property Description

Villa Volterra is sinonymous with luxury and elegance with a 360 degree view over the Tuscan hills. It represents the traditional, Tuscan architecture, remodernized to give its guests an unforgettable “full immersion” experience. Originally a small, rural building in stone, it has been transformed into a house of design, suspended above valleys, woods, olive groves and the sea on the horizon. The villa, reconstructed with the original stone, the clean lines of the architecture, the shades of the structure and the vast panorama, help the guest to live the history, the attraction and the legends of this area. The project has been created by a famous archictectural firm, Studio Milani and is inspired by the relationship between contemporary style and the countryside……the stone blends with the transparence of corten steel and glass fittings, Formed by three principal blocks, the villa includes refined design, where the fascination of “rustic” blends with the modern, minimalistic form.

The large fenced in garden, 8.000 sq mt, which surrounds the villa, is full of ornamental plants and has an infitinty swimming pool 7×14 mt, 1.10-1.70 deep, surrounded by a stone carpet, heated on request, with an electric cover to keep the temperature in the night and with an enchanting view over the valley and a Jacuzzi for wellbeing and relaxation. To complete the particular structure, a series of first-class experiences and services offered to the guests, have been created to satisfy all types of requests. The outdoor living area, the pool and the jacuzzi capture the essence of the surrounding nature. The unforgettable sunsets and the beautiful view of the hills and Volterra result in a dream-like experience for the guests. An enchanted place wher you can turn off the daily franctic existance and reconnect with pure nature. The outside area represents the top of natural wellness.

Accommodations

The style preserves the historical charachter in a modern style which, combined, reach a harmonious balance between the contemporary and the rural worlds.

Ground Floor

The heart of the building, the living area, has a panoramic dining room which looks out over the pool and the surrounding garden through a magnificent very large stained glass window. The idea of “open-space” living permits the lounge area to open onto the dining area with a large sofa’, modern fireplace and an open kitchen and to live in free spaces to share with friends continuosly, always immersed in a natural special light and also with the outside view that you can see from any corner. The kitchen, fully equipped, has a dishwasher, microwave and electric ovens and a stove with induction hob; a double fridge with icemaker, freezer and canteen. The villa has three double bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms with crystal shower; two on the ground floor with a walk-out into the garden.

First Floor

The third bedroom with ensuite bathrooms with crystal shower, on the upper floor, a suite, has also a beautiful view of the surrounding countryside.

Outdoor area: Alfresco dining, Aromatic garden, BBQ, EV Charge Point, Heated swimming pool, Outdoor Jacuzzi (heated), Outdoor seating, Parking, Ping pong table, Private swimming pool, Stunning view

Kitchen: American coffee machine, Blender, Coffee machines (moka), Dishwasher, Espresso machine, Fridge for wine, Fridge with freezer, Fridge with ice maker, Fruit juicer, Fully equipped kitchen, Microwave, Oven, Toaster, Kettle

Safety: Alarm system, Emergency first aid kit, Fenced property, Fire extinguisher, Smoke detector

Gym and Wellness: Cyclette, Gym

Entertenment: Bluetooth Bose acoustic speakers, DVD player, Netflix, Sound system, TV set

House rules: Children welcome, No smoking, Wheelchair accessible

pages.mainHtml:
100% Made in Italy Shopping & Crafts

In Tuscany, Italy, popular shopping and crafts include:

  1. Leather Goods: Renowned for finely crafted bags and accessories.

  2. Artisanal Ceramics: Montelupo Fiorentino is known for vibrant and detailed pottery.

  3. Textiles: High-quality handmade fabrics, linens, and silk products.

  4. Gold and Jewelry: Florence's Ponte Vecchio boasts historic goldsmith shops.

  5. Wine and Olive Oil: Tuscany's wines (like Chianti) and olive oils are exceptional.

  6. Paper Products: Florence's paper-making tradition yields elegant stationery.

  7. Woodcrafts: Look for intricate wooden items, from furniture to decor.

  8. Truffles: Tuscany's famed truffles result in gourmet products like truffle oil.

  9. 100% made in Italy suits, sun glasses, shoes, shirts, and more authentic Italian products.

pages.title: Truffle Tasting
pages.mainHtml:
Truffle Tasting

Truffle tasting in Tuscany is a sensory delight that immerses you in the earthy and aromatic world of these prized fungi. Tuscany is renowned for its truffles, and the experience typically involves exploring the region's woodlands with skilled truffle hunters and their trained dogs.

As you venture through the picturesque landscapes, you'll witness the excitement of the truffle dogs as they locate these elusive treasures beneath the soil. Truffle tastings often take place in charming local restaurants, where the freshly harvested truffles are incorporated into a variety of dishes.

The flavor of Tuscan truffles is distinctive, offering a robust, earthy, and slightly nutty taste. White truffles, which are highly prized, have a more delicate and pungent aroma compared to black truffles. Commonly shaved or grated over pasta, risotto, or simple dishes like scrambled eggs, truffles add a luxurious and unforgettable touch to the culinary experience.

The truffle tasting experience in Tuscany not only tantalizes the taste buds but also provides a unique opportunity to appreciate the art of truffle hunting and the deep connection between the region's cuisine and its natural surroundings.

pages.title: Tuscany Culture
pages.mainHtml:
Tuscany Culture

Tuscany, a region in central Italy, boasts a rich history dating back to ancient times. It was home to the Etruscans before becoming part of the Roman Empire. During the Renaissance, Tuscany flourished as a center of art, literature, and culture. The powerful Medici family played a pivotal role in shaping the region's history. Today, Tuscany is celebrated for its historic cities, picturesque landscapes, and enduring cultural legacy.

Italian Local Guides can be available at your request. Contact us for details and pricing.

Tuscany Museums

Tuscany's museums showcase a wealth of artistic and historical treasures:

  1. Uffizi Gallery: Home to Renaissance masterpieces in Florence.

  2. Accademia Gallery: Houses Michelangelo's David and other Renaissance art.

  3. Pitti Palace: A vast complex in Florence featuring multiple museums.

  4. Museo dell'Opera del Duomo: Displays sculptures and art from Florence's cathedral complex.

  5. Museo Galileo: Dedicated to the history of science in Florence.

  6. Museo Nazionale del Bargello: Exhibits Renaissance sculptures in Florence.

  7. National Archaeological Museum of Florence: Showcases Etruscan, Roman, and Egyptian artifacts.

  8. Museum of San Salvi: Features religious art in Florence.

  9. Pinacoteca di Siena: Displays Sienese paintings in Siena.

  10. Leonardo da Vinci Museum: Located in Vinci, dedicated to da Vinci's life and inventions.

Each museum offers a unique glimpse into Tuscany's cultural and artistic heritage.

pages.title: Tuscany Farms
pages.mainHtml:
Tuscany Farms

Tuscany farm tours are a feast for the senses, taking you through picturesque landscapes of vineyards and olive groves. These tours often include wine tastings, visits to cheese and dairy farms, and experiences with local farmers. You can learn about olive oil production, indulge in farm-to-table meals, and even go truffle hunting. The tours offer an educational and cultural journey, connecting you with the region's rich agricultural traditions.

pages.title: Enjoy Tuscany with Your Children
pages.mainHtml:
Enjoy Tuscany with Your Children

Super Tuscany offers a unique and unforgettable entertainment experience for both adults and children. Our mission is to make sure every guest has the time of their life.

We believe in the inherent value and uniqueness of every child or family member. We are committed to organizing an unforgettable dream vacation with warm, nurturing, and inclusive environments where all children and family members, including those with special needs or disabilities, can thrive. Our specialty trained staff works closely with the owners of the villas to find the best situation for you and your family.

Italian Local Guides can be available at your request. Contact us for details and pricing.

images.alt: The Leaning Tower of Pisa, Italy, front view on a sunny day with a clear sky during the golden hour light, architectural photography in high resolution. Image by Austin Loveing

A long path in the "Boboli garden" park is lined with tall trees and plants, forming an archway that creates beautiful shadows on both sides of it. The ground beneath these tree branches can be seen covered by leaves or fallen petals from different types of flowers. At one end of the tunnel there's another entrance leading to more greenery.

A closeup of wooden Pinocchio toys, each with long skinny legs and short arms, wearing red shirts and green shorts pants, sitting on display at an outdoor market in Pinocchio Park tuscany, Italy. The crowd is diverse, everyone seems to be looking up as if they have just seen something amazing.

A photo shows two women and one boy wearing beige khakis and blue gloves, sitting next to each other in the Pistoia's zoo playing with penguins. An older female stands behind them, helping make petting.

A path through an exotic garden in the collodi's butterfly house, tuscany, with colorful butterflies and parrots, surrounded by lush greenery. The scene is captured in vibrant colors and natural light creating a magical atmosphere. A butterfly is on the edge while another sits in the other side. This picture rapresent the enchanting ambiance of nature's beauty

An architectural photo of an art installation in the Chianti sculptural park made from blue solar panels arranged in the shape of "mon commas" reflecting on water. The background is a park landscape in daylight.

The interior of the exhibition hall of Museo leonardiano is designed with stone walls and wooden beams and contains display cases containing ancient tools designed by the genius of Leonardo da Vinci. Hanging from the ceiling are curved instruments made of wood that look like wings. On the walls of both sides there are monitors showing, in an interactive and immersive way, various Leonardo da Vinci's engineering projects.
A picturesque beach in tuscany coast, Italy with crystal clear turquoise waters and golden sand.
the image represents a swimming pool in a water park with children having fun inside. The image conveys how much fun you can have in a water park with your children.

A group of people riding bicycles along a path in Tuscany, Italy. The background features red poppies and green grasses with cypress trees on both sides. One person is wearing a blue top while another wears white pants. This scene conveys an active lifestyle, summer mood and sense of freedom and adventure.

A black wall with bioluminescent little drawings made by children, sea creatures and plant life painted on it. The walls of the room glow in vibrant colors under ultraviolet lighting. It is the wall of a children's museum. This picture brings together art installation, natural science education, and fun.

A group of children wearing chef hats and aprons are sitting at a table. In front of them is an empty blackboard with white chalk. they are surrounded by various cooking tools such as a rolling pin, dough ball, mixing bowl and other ingredients. They have their hands working together to make pizza, with happy smiles visible on their faces, creating an atmosphere filled with fun.

Photo of a young girl licking chocolate ice cream from a cone, sitting on a blue outdoor chair at a cafe with her mother holding a coffee cup in the background, the focus is on her face and hand as she eats the gelato. Image by Amy Vann

A group of baby goats playing in the barn, with one goat chasing another and all standing on yellow straw. One is brown and white, while others have black spots or fur. They appear playful and lively as they run around each other. In front of them lies some hay for eating. A wooden fence can be seen at the top left corner of the frame. The scene depicts baby goats playing in a style reminiscent of a barn scene.

Aerial view of rolling hills and vineyards in Tuscany, Italy, at sunrise with mist rising from the ground. The photo was taken in the style of professional travel photographers using high-quality cameras

Matera, Italy's ancient city with its variations of orange and yellow lights glowing in the evening sky. The view is from above overlooking many buildings and rock structures. There’s an old church tower visible at one end of town. It captures a panoramic view of Matera, which has thousands of houses carved into rocks. In contrast to the golden hues of sunset lighting, it creates a magical atmosphere.

italian Tortellini with tomato sauce and basil on a white plate, food photography presented in the style of award winning photography. The delicious looking food has soft shadows with clean sharp focus and a bokeh background.
A group of friends toasting with red wine glasses at an outdoor gathering, closeup shot focusing on the elegant glass and hands holding it, soft natural lighting creating a warm atmosphere.
A table with food and wine, an Italian pasta dish on the left side of the table, bruschetta in the front right corner, green plants behind. tipical italian meal.

A photo of an elderly couple hiking in the tuscany Mountains, with their dog and cows grazing nearby. The woman is wearing shorts and a backpack while they enjoy nature's beauty on a sunny day. the image represents a happy family carrying out outdoor activities in the Tuscan nature.

A chef is cooking in the kitchen, holding an open wok with flames and flying food inside it. The background shows stainless steel appliances and various ingredients on the counter. High contrast lighting highlights details of fire flame, vegetables and meat pieces floating around the pan. Capture the dynamic motion as he throws fresh herbs into his dish.

pages.title: Why Super Tuscany
headings: Local Professionals Will Help You Tailor Your Dream Vacation
pages.mainHtml:
Why Super Tuscany

Passion • Honesty • Professionalism • Trustworthy

We are aware you can find villas in everywhere, and you are asking yourself why should you trust us, rather than others.

The answer is very simple, like our motto's.

For us, this is a passion and a genuine love for people and hospitality before becoming a job.

We don't pest you with hundred emails or advs, because for us, the best reward is being contacting by you and then your friends or other member of your families, year after year, confirming that we are making your dream vacation a memorable ones.

Your joy fulfill our days and your trust is better than any reviews.

Everyone can rent a villa, but only Super Tuscany can make you live the classic "Dolce Vita" that you have been seeing in those movies and make you feel like a local Italian rather than a tourist.

Comforts or Experiences

This dream vacation is all about you.

You can find comforts in all over the world, but the difference here is that you are in Tuscany, surrounded by thousand years of culture and traditions.

So, you don't need to move a finger if you need to relax, because we know how to bring a piece of Tuscany to your villa.

Real People & Not Automatic Responses

When you give us your trust, we won't never disappointed you. For this reason, every time you send emails or making a phone calls, you will talk directly with Christian Ferrara, the founder and his team.

Nobody likes to be answered by an automatic algorithm.

We put our face on it everyday, and you know where to find us.

Our 24/7 customer service will constantly work with you from the moment you decide to contact us to the moment you will take off to go back to your country.

Local Professionals Will Help You Tailor Your Dream Vacation

Since we opened the door at Super Tuscany, we helped you to craft this journey of a lifetime, because we know how to be next to you minute by minute to create a perfection around this dream.

We use our knowledge, professionalism and expertise to touch every single details.

If you are nervous, don't worry, we will be with you.

If you don't how to decor your villa, don't worry, we will do it for you following your basic guidelines.

In our Italian team, we have architects, contruction's entrepreneurs, hair stylists, masseuses, clothing stylists, florist experts and much more, so whatever is your requests and your need, don't worry, we will help you.

Unmatched Experience

We are a group of 25 friends. United by a shared passion, culture, and vision, they form an artistic ensemble, collaborating to craft an experience tailored for you.

Our recipe is elegantly simple, yet potent—infused with passion, honesty, professionalism, trustworthiness, and an authentic love for people and hospitality. When you embark on this journey with us, you're not just a customer; you become a cherished friend for life.

Italy owns more than half of the world’s art treasures, and Tuscany is the home of many of the greatest artists and architects that have ever lived. Our team of Italian guides will show you the most secluded areas and secret spots that are usually only accessible to locals. There is a wealth of beautiful sites to behold beyond the commonly visited tourism spots, and you will be left speechless admiring the ancient monasteries, century-old castles, fortresses, historic homes and villas, independent local museums, archeological sites, spots with the best vistas, and all of the UNESCO heritage sites.

pages.title: Wine Tasting
pages.mainHtml:
Wine Tasting

Wine tasting in Tuscany is a captivating experience that beckons aficionados and novices alike. It entails an exploration of esteemed vineyards, where varietals like Chianti, Brunello di Montalcino, and Vino Nobile di Montepulciano take center stage. Amidst the rolling landscapes, visitors partake in a sensory journey, unraveling the nuances of each wine.

These tastings encompass informative discussions on grape varieties, terroir intricacies, and the meticulous aging processes that characterize Tuscan wines. Complementing the tasting sessions, pairings with local cheeses, olive oils, and traditional Tuscan cuisine elevate the gastronomic encounter.

Beyond the palate, the warmth of Tuscan winemakers and the picturesque surroundings contribute to an enriching sojourn, making wine tasting in Tuscany an intellectually and aesthetically rewarding escapade.

Italian Local Guides can be available at your request. Contact us for details and pricing.
